decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted RPA/111/CR/101, RPA/111/CR/102, RPA/111/CR/103 , site location plan  received 04/04/2013   therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The single storey rear extension  hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 111 Cranleigh Road, Feltham.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  flank wall of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the house
